description: Nombre de trajets par jour du service vélos en libre-service Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by JCDecaux. Nombre de trajets quotidiens des vélos en libre-service Naolib à Nantes Métropole à partir du 22 avril 2008 Ce jeu de données fournit, pour chaque jour le nombre de trajets des vélos en libre-service Naolib qui ont été effectués. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, Naolib, Statistiques. The portal shows 6,607 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License-ODBL (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
